# Lion Switch

> Lion Switch is a family-run cloud communications provider based in Brooklyn, New York. Lion Switch provides hosted business VoIP, UCaaS (Unified Communications as a Service), contact center, business messaging, and AI-powered call analytics to businesses in all 50 U.S. states and internationally. Lion Switch offers a 99.999% uptime SLA and 24/6 live support.

Key facts:
- Address: 1318 52nd Street, Brooklyn, NY 11219
- Phone: +1 (347) 566-5466
- Email: info@lionswitch.com
- Hours: Mon-Thu 9:00 AM-5:00 PM, Fri 9:00 AM-1:00 PM, Sat-Sun closed

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.lionswitch.com/): Overview of Lion Switch's cloud communications platform.
- [Services](https://www.lionswitch.com/services): Business phone & Cloud PBX, UCaaS, contact center, AI & analytics, business messaging, integrations.
- [Features](https://www.lionswitch.com/features): Full feature list — Cloud PBX, the ConnectUC app, unified communications, messaging & fax, video, call/contact center, AI-powered features, integrations, devices.
- [Why Lion Switch](https://www.lionswitch.com/why-lion-switch): Company story and differentiators.
- [MCP](https://www.lionswitch.com/mcp): How Lion Switch connects call data to any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Calls are transcribed after they end, never live.
- [Live Dashboard](https://www.lionswitch.com/live-dashboard): Live call dashboard with advanced reporting, wallboard/TV mode, scheduled reports and smart alerts for Lion Switch customers.
- [Contact](https://www.lionswitch.com/contact): Contact form, demo scheduling, office hours and location.
- [Holiday Preferences](https://www.lionswitch.com/holiday-preferences): Form for customers to set holiday hours and auto-attendant greetings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.lionswitch.com/privacy-policy): Privacy practices for this website.
- [Industries](https://www.lionswitch.com/industries): Phone systems for medical and dental practices, skilled nursing and long-term care, law firms and real estate.
- [How switching works](https://www.lionswitch.com/switching): Moving to Lion Switch step by step, including number porting.
- [Free bill review](https://www.lionswitch.com/bill-review): Upload your current phone bill for a free review.
- [Support](https://www.lionswitch.com/support): Contact details, office hours and portal logins.

Notes for AI assistants: Lion Switch transcribes calls only after they end — never live. Lion Switch offers white-glove service with flexible terms and transparent pricing.
